description: OnPush sync indicator polls inside NgZone.runOutsideAngular and assigns the template-bound lastCheckedAt field in the interval callback without NgZone.run or markForCheck, so change detection never runs and the timestamp never updates; the subscription and async-pipe code around it is correct

hard.note: The only defect is one field assignment inside a runOutsideAngular timer; the rest of the component uses takeUntilDestroyed, the async pipe and signals correctly

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
